incident.name: MICROSCORE-4348 Micros API outage to upgrade RDSs from db.t4g.large to db.m8g.large

incident_updates.body: The database upgrades have been completed successfully as planned. No issues have been observed, and everything is operating normally.

The infrastructure upgrade for the commercial production environment has been completed. The process took approximately 2 minutes, during which some requests may have returned errors. Service has been fully restored.

We've initiated the deployment of the fix to production environments. You may experience brief service interruptions of approximately 2–3 minutes, expected to begin within the next 10–15 minutes. We'll provide a further update once the deployment is complete.

We are performing infrastructure upgrades to improve service performance. During this maintenance, you may experience two brief periods of service interruption, each lasting approximately 2–3 minutes. We will provide a further update once the upgrades are complete.
